svg.title: Partition materials compared, edge view
svg.desc: Five partition doors side by side, each cut through and seen edge on at the same scale: phenolic 3/4 inch, layered kraft paper core with melamine faces; solid plastic (HDPE) 1 inch, one solid sheet; plastic laminate 1 inch, particleboard core with laminate faces and an edge band; powder coated steel 1 inch and stainless steel, steel faces over a honeycomb core.
svg.text: Same scale, each door cut through and seen edge on. Stainless drawn at 1" (not confirmed).
Schematic: shows the principle, not one manufacturer's product.
